Featuring 802.3bt standards, intuitive touch LCD design, Long Reach PoE technology over fiber optic cabling, coaxial cabling or UTP cabling, and PLANET exclusive intelligent PoE Management functions, all the requirements can be met for such applications as IP surveillance, IP communications, POS systems, PoE lighting and more. Our full range of PoE product lines include 95W 802.3bt PoE++/ 30W 802.3at PoE+ Managed Switches, Industrial flat-type PoE+ Switches, PoE Injectors, Splitters, Extenders designed for both indoor and outdoor environments. Wireless Solution Proxim’s purpose-designed technology offers highly efficient alternatives to leased lines, and wired distribution systems, but with the mobility, flexibility, and rapid deployment benefits of true carrier-class wireless solutions. Industrial Network Solution PLANET Industrial Ethernet equipment is compliant with various industrial protocols and ITS certifications such as MQTT, Modbus, SCADA, EtherCAT EN50155 and E-Mark to meet all the transmission needs, be it Information, Control or Device.
